mentions.name: Juggling Octocat GitHub Badge
mentions.description: A GitHub profile badge that renders an octocat juggling one ball for each project the viewer contributed to over the past week, with variations such as the octocat wearing sunglasses or going to the mountain. Visitors can follow a link to see stats and get their own badge.
mentions.source_excerpt: Today I built a github badge that shows an octocat juggling with as many balls as projects you contributed past week.
